title: hostMemory
responsibility: Parses platform memory counters and obtains current host availability with an explicit pressure level.

inputs.name: macMemory.text
inputs.description: Platform memory diagnostic output in its native text format.

inputs.name: macMemory.pressure
inputs.description: macOS memory-pressure level emitted by sysctl.

inputs.name: macMemory.total
inputs.description: Total physical memory bytes used to bound parsed available pages.

inputs.name: linuxMemory.text
inputs.description: Platform memory diagnostic output in its native text format.

outputs.name: macMemory
outputs.description: Total and available bytes plus the parsed macOS pressure level; unknown levels remain unknown.

outputs.name: linuxMemory
outputs.description: Total and available bytes with critical pressure when less than five percent remains.

outputs.name: hostMemory
outputs.description: Actual platform memory observation; unsupported or unreadable probes reject.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Unreadable or invalid platform counters and unsupported platforms reject instead of inventing available capacity.
